headlines.title: 반도체 셧다운 막았다 … 노사 성과급 제도화·배분율 전격 합의

headlines.title: 삼성전자 협상 결렬 …사측 “노조 요구 과도” 노조 “총파업 돌입”
headlines.summary: [앵커] 삼성전자 노사의 협상이 마라톤 협상에도 불구하고 오늘 오전 결국 결렬됐습니다. 사측은 노조의 요구가 과도하다고 했고,  노조는 중노위의 조정안에 사측이 거부했다는 입장입니다. 노조는 내일 예정했던 총파업에 돌입하기로 했습니다. 문예슬 기자가 보도합니다.

headlines.title: 삼성전자 노사협상 발묶인 사이, 中반도체 반사이익
headlines.summary: [삼성전자 파업 직전 유보] 양대 메모리업체 CXMT-YMTC 기업공개 추진하며 실탄 준비 韓노사갈등 이후 주가도 급등 23일 경기 평택시 고덕동 삼성전자 평택캠퍼스에서 열린 삼성전자 노동조합 공동투쟁본부 ‘4·23 투쟁 결의대회’에서 조합원들이 구호를 외치고 있다. 2026.4.23.

headlines.title: 엔화 아니라 달러 빌린다 … 한·일 통화스와프 재연장 촉각
headlines.summary: 달러 기반 계약… 금융안정에 도움 이재명 대통령과 다카이치 사나에 일본 총리가 19일 경북 안동 한 호텔에서 소인수 정상회담을 하고 있다. 연합뉴스 11월 만료되는 ‘한·일 통화스와프’ 연장 여부에 관심이 쏠리고 있다. 최근 한·일 정상회담에서 양국은 이 문제를 공식 의제로 다루지는 않았으나 금융안전망 보강 차원에서 재연장 가능성이 거론되고 있다.

headlines.title: 한·일 ‘ 원유·석유제품 스와프 ’ 추진 배경 은?… 한국 은 정제 , 일본은...

headlines.title: 韓 유조선 호르무즈 통과 로 체류 선원 9명↓…116명 남아

한국 경제는 1분기 '깜짝 성장'에 힘입어 소비심리가 급반등하고 기대인플레이션은 하락하는 등 국내 경기 회복 기대감이 높아지고 있으나, 금리는 여전히 무겁게 오르는 흐름 속에 채권시장의 불확실성이 지속되고 있다. 씨티는 내년 국고채 발행 규모 축소와 보험사 수요 부진을 근거로 수익률 커브 정상화를 전망하고 있으며, 일부 전문가들은 내년 중 투자 관점이 주식에서 채권으로 이동하고 반도체발 인플레이션(칩플레이션)도 진정될 가능성을 제시하고 있다. 한편 미국 증시와 실물경제의 괴리가 36년 만에 가장 크다는 무디스 수석 이코노미스트의 경고는 글로벌 투자 환경의 불안정성을 상기시키며, 이에 호응하듯 서학개미들은 미국 빅테크 자산을 처분하고 2조 원 규모의 자금을 국내로 회귀시켜 삼성전자·SK하이닉스 등 국내 반도체주를 매수하는 움직임을 보이고 있다. 국내 에너지 정책 면에서는 전력망의 민간 개방과 RPS(신재생에너지 공급의무화제도) 폐지안이 상임위를 통과하며 에너지 시장 구조의 대전환이 본격화되는 신호탄을 쐈다. 종합하면, 오늘의 경제 흐름은 **국내 경기 회복 기대와 금리·채권시장 불안의 공존**, 그

key_headlines.title: Producer Price Inflation Hits 28-Year High Amid Energy and Currency Pressures
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's April producer price index surged 2.5% month-on-month, the largest increase since the 1998 IMF crisis, driven by rising global oil prices and a stronger dollar, with concerns about eventual pass-through to consumer prices.

key_headlines.title: Historic Private Power Grid Opening and RPS Abolition Approved for Energy Transformation
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's standing committee approved landmark legislation to open the national power grid to private operators and abolish the Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS), marking a major shift in energy policy.

key_headlines.title: US Fed Signals Potential Rate Hikes as Inflation Remains Above Target
key_headlines.summary: Minutes from the April FOMC meeting revealed that multiple Federal Reserve officials believe additional rate increases may be appropriate if inflation continues above the 2% target, contradicting market expectations of easing.

key_headlines.title: Q1 Growth Surprise Lifts Consumer Sentiment While Inflation Expectations Moderate
key_headlines.summary: First-quarter economic growth exceeded expectations, boosting consumer confidence and semiconductor-driven optimism, though one-year inflation expectations declined to 2.8%, still above the central bank's target.

key_headlines.title: Semiconductor Boom Drives Record Bonuses and Real Estate Speculation in Tech Hubs
key_headlines.summary: South Korean chipmakers, automakers, and battery makers are distributing record performance bonuses, sparking concerns about real estate speculation in semiconductor cluster areas as semiconductor demand surges.

sections.Hot Economy News: South Korea's economy is experiencing mixed signals with strong semiconductor-driven momentum offsetting inflationary pressures. Producer prices jumped to their highest level in 28 years, echoing IMF-era volatility, while consumer sentiment rebounded sharply following better-than-expected Q1 GDP growth. The semiconductor sector is booming, leading to record corporate bonuses and speculation about property price surges in chip manufacturing clusters. However, expectations for future inflation have moderated slightly despite remaining above target levels. Energy costs and currency depreciation continue to fuel immediate price pressures that could eventually reach consumers.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: April producer price inflation surged 2.5% month-on-month, marking the steepest monthly increase since February 1998 during the Asian financial crisis, driven primarily by soaring global oil prices and currency depreciation. This sharp rise raises significant concerns about delayed transmission to consumer prices through supply chains. The Bank of Korea's May consumer outlook survey showed improved business sentiment supported by strong semiconductor performance, though one-year inflation expectations remained at 2.8%, above the central bank's 2% target. Energy prices and raw material costs continue to pose upside risks to price stability despite some moderation in inflation psychology.
sections.Financial Markets: US Treasury yields have surged to crisis-era levels, with the Federal Reserve signaling potential rate increases rather than cuts if inflation persists above 2% targets. The FOMC minutes revealed multiple officials view additional rate hikes as appropriate, defying market expectations of imminent easing despite tight labor markets. Real yields have also climbed alongside nominal rates, triggering synchronized sell-offs in both stocks and bonds as investors reassess inflation and growth dynamics. The won-dollar exchange rate continues to hover around 1,500 won per dollar amid persistent global rate differentials. Korean corporate bonds and bond ETFs are attracting renewed interest as yields rise, though risks from high interest rates and currency exposure remain elevated.
sections.Industry & Technology: South Korea's semiconductor, automotive, and battery sectors are experiencing historic profitability, sparking record-breaking performance bonus payouts that reflect the capital-intensive nature of these industries. Deeptech startups focused on battery recycling, power grid management, and AI-driven energy optimization are attracting significant investment as industries race to solve infrastructure constraints limiting growth. Energy supply emerges as a critical bottleneck alongside chips, with AI and renewable energy technologies becoming essential to sustaining manufacturing competitiveness. Korean companies are showcasing manufacturing AI and consumer goods in Vietnam as bilateral trade relations strengthen, with particular interest in Korean robotics and digital transformation technologies. Government trade agencies are actively promoting Korean AI and manufacturing solutions to Southeast Asian markets to capitalize on growing demand.
sections.Real Estate: Seoul apartment prices accelerated with weekly gains reaching 0.31%, the highest level in recent months, driven primarily by acute jeonse (key money lease) shortages triggering cascading demand into purchase markets. Districts like Seongbuk and Gwanak saw weekly price increases of 0.45% as mounting competition in the leasing market pushes tenants and property investors toward outright purchases. Semiconductor cluster regions are experiencing speculative attention as record bonuses and industry boom expectations fuel property demand in chip manufacturing areas. Experts attribute sustained Seoul real estate strength to underlying income growth and structural supply constraints rather than demographic expansion, with short-term supply policies remaining inadequate. The jeonse market tightness is simultaneously creating upward pressure on monthly rents, adding urgency to tenant demand for purchase alternatives.
sections.International Economy: The Federal Reserve faces mounting internal pressure toward monetary tightening as multiple officials signal readiness to increase rates if inflation remains elevated, marking a notable shift from earlier dovish signals following Trump's election. April FOMC minutes revealed consensus that 2% inflation is increasingly unlikely without additional monetary restriction, though external uncertainty from Trump administration tariff policies remains high. The CME FedWatch tool indicates 51.1% probability of a December rate increase, reflecting hawkish policy sentiment despite strong labor market data and energy sector challenges. Trump administration transition discussions include potential leadership changes at the Federal Reserve, though the incoming Fed chair has indicated commitment to data-dependent policymaking. Persistent US rate elevation continues to strengthen the dollar globally, pressuring emerging market currencies and creating capital flows that complicate policy decisions across Asia.
sections.AI & Economy: AI is positioned to become the primary driver of future GDP growth alongside carbon neutrality initiatives, displacing infrastructure and real estate investment as the dominant economic engine. Biotech and healthcare sectors are emerging as first-movers in AI-driven productivity improvements, with the challenge lying in translating AI capability into actual revenue and profit generation across the real economy. Major tech companies including Microsoft, Google, and Amazon are intensifying competition to develop and deploy proprietary AI chips as custom semiconductors become critical to infrastructure cost control. Nvidia continues dominating the AI boom with record quarterly revenues spanning 12 consecutive quarters, underscoring the enormous capital intensity required across AI infrastructure buildout. Historical precedent suggests AI costs will decline dramatically following massive investment waves, similar to smartphone and electric vehicle adoption trajectories.
sections.Others: South Korea's labor ministry is engaging international labor organizations to develop AI transition models for presentation to the global community, signaling policy focus on managing workforce displacement. SpaceX filed for IPO with a potential valuation reaching up to 300 trillion won, though analysts warn of excessive concentration risk around Elon Musk's decision-making. Investment authorities highlight that true AI disruption protection comes from assets with structural competitive advantages and limited substitutability rather than AI exposure itself. KOTRA is expanding support for 38 small and medium enterprises establishing overseas offices through virtual trade offices, addressing challenges from deteriorating global economic conditions and changing trade environments. Government initiatives emphasize building overseas networks and market presence for export-focused SMEs struggling with reduced global demand and protectionist trade trends.
